day_to_day.text: Much of the work is shaping what goes into the agent's context, and teams rebuild their approach as they learn.

citations.quote: It's an experimental science—and we've rebuilt our agent framework four times, each time after discovering a better way to shape context.

day_to_day.text: Practitioners give deterministic code the computation and keep the model for the ambiguous reasoning.

citations.quote: Reasoning tasks involve ambiguity, which makes them a natural fit for LLMs, but computation tasks require deterministic outputs and are better handled by software built for that purpose.
If you can write the rule, write the rule, and save agents for work that's well understood but not fully scriptable.

day_to_day.text: Tracing and monitoring every step of an agent is part of the daily job.

citations.quote: You cannot put an agent into production without live diagnostics.
For us, that meant monitoring AI outputs just as much as we monitor the data, system, and code that powers it.

typical_week.text: Results are checked against ground truth, deterministic code or a person before they are trusted.

typical_week.text: Agents are measured against expected outputs and real usage, much like a new hire.

pain_points.text: Adding more instructions to the prompt rarely fixes an unreliable agent.

citations.quote: The prompt grows, but the underlying reliability problem remains.
We affectionately refer to this manual process of architecture searching, prompt fiddling, and empirical guesswork as "Stochastic Graduate Descent".

pain_points.text: Adding more agents does not automatically make the system more reliable, and errors compound across steps.

pain_points.text: Failures are a normal part of multi-step runs: rate limits, loops and silent failures.

citations.quote: In multi-step tasks, failure is not the exception; it's part of the loop.
This isn't just about elegant code; it's about avoiding runaway cloud bills, reputational damage from hallucinated outputs, and the sheer operational nightmare of a silent failure in production.

pain_points.text: Latency and cost are constant concerns in long agent runs.

citations.quote: If I had to choose just one metric, I'd argue that the KV-cache hit rate is the single most important metric for a production-stage AI agent.
